_comment: Player-facing vocabulary. World bible sections 1, 9 and 10. Change a word here and it changes everywhere.

facilityBlurbs.mine: Cuts timber and ore out of the ground, and sells it.
facilityBlurbs.refinery: Works timber and ore into something worth more. Your best earner.
facilityBlurbs.construction_yard: Builds everything else on this island. Costs gold to keep.
facilityBlurbs.training_facility: Drills companies of marines and militia. Costs gold to keep.
facilityBlurbs.shipyard: Lays down hulls. Nothing to build here until the fleets arrive.
facilityBlurbs.fort: A battery on the harbour wall. Fires on any enemy hull lying off the island, whether or not you have a fleet there.
facilityBlurbs.boom: A chain across the harbour mouth. A landing has to cut it first, and a lone raider cannot close the port.
